source_snapshot.items: PCIe Gen5 application-level testing for performance
source_snapshot.procedure: Run latest NVDiag RIN test_id Power, thermal.

old_problem: RIN Power/thermal and pcie_gen5_app_perf are different proprietary scopes; no performance/power/thermal oracle exists.
disposition_reason: Public PCIe rules cannot select a proprietary NVDiag module or invent project thresholds; ED-15/16 keep the core scope pending.
decision_basis: Read all row256 cells and history2858.
Preserved Gen5 application-performance purpose and RIN wording without cross-credit.

test_case.test_name: Gen5 application-performance NVDiag pending module decision
test_case.purpose: Run the approved Gen5 application-performance module and evaluate signed performance, power and thermal oracles.
test_case.test_command: After approval, verify artifacts/topology, run the selected module once under monitoring, retain full per-path metrics and health logs.
test_case.expected_result: All required paths meet signed performance and health limits and SUT remains operational.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Generic PASS or a different Power/thermal module cannot prove application performance.
test_case.recovery: Stop on anomaly, restore package/service state and verify links/GPUs/OS.

project_authority: NVDiag internals and project thresholds are proprietary.
